item.title: Are digital wallets reshaping how visitors spend in Mazatlán?
item.description: Mazatlán’s appeal has always rested on sun, seafood, and an easygoing rhythm; yet, the way visitors pay for those experiences is changing rapidly. item.description: To help strengthen operational security capabilities, Grupo ARHE donated equipment to the Mexican Navy (SEMAR) this Thursday in Mazatlán.
